clue.text: Rural set-up that's distant, miles to the south

indicators.note: in a down clue, to the south means placed below, so this piece comes after the other

parts.note: distant means far away

explanation.surface: A remote smallholding lies some miles further south.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm is the archetypal agricultural establishment in the countryside.

clue.text: Got very hot over a woman

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: to fry is to become very hot, as in the sun or a pan

explanation.surface: Someone overheated while dealing with a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Frieda is a female first name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: Boss to consider finishing early

indicators.note: finishing early means the word stops one letter short of its end

parts.note: to study something is to consider it closely

explanation.surface: A manager means to think things over and leave work before time.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is a boss in the sense of a raised knob or ornament on a surface.

clue.text: Naughty little creature — it's knocked over hamper

indicators.note: knocked over in a down clue turns the whole run upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: an elf is a small mischievous being of folklore
it's gives ITS, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A mischievous imp has toppled a picnic basket.
explanation.definitionFit: To stifle progress is to hamper or restrain it; both are verbs of obstruction.

clue.text: Possessed what was necessary for game and made whoopee

definitions.text: Possessed what was necessary for game
definitions.meaning: literally, owned the one item needed to play a sport

explanation.definitionFit: Owning the needed sphere for a match is the literal reading; the idiom means enjoyed oneself enormously.

clue.text: Record agent and worker not agreeing

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
a rep is a sales representative or agent
the worker ant is the crossword's stock worker

explanation.surface: A music label's representative and an employee fall out.
explanation.definitionFit: Discrepant figures are inconsistent, failing to tally with one another.

clue.text: Inside vehicle find your broken implement

indicators.note: Inside says the rearranged letters are placed within the vehicle word

parts.note: a cart is a simple wheeled vehicle

indicators.note: broken means the letters of your are smashed up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a damaged tool inside their car.
explanation.definitionFit: To implement a plan is to execute it, put it into effect.

clue.text: Individual needs to get right round America — not easy

parts.note: one is a single individual
O is round in shape
US is the United States of America

explanation.surface: A lone person must travel all around the United States, which is hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: An onerous task is burdensome, demanding effort rather than coming easily.

clue.text: Soldier in road cut down — extremely sad

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the shortened road
cut down means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a track is a rough road
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier was killed on the road, which is terribly upsetting.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragic describes something deeply distressing, extremely sad.

clue.text: A member of the House before presenting current measure

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament, sitting in the House of Commons
ere is a poetic word for before

explanation.surface: A Member of Parliament speaks before setting out a present-day policy.
explanation.definitionFit: The ampere is the SI unit by which electric current is measured.

clue.text: Bold opposition of French fellow anticipating marriage

parts.note: de is French for of
a man engaged to be married is a fiancé

explanation.surface: A Frenchman about to wed shows brazen resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Defiance is open resistance, bold opposition to authority.

clue.text: One of the FIFA bosses, say, in an advantageous position?

parts.note: one gives the indefinite article A
FIFA runs world football, so each of its bosses is, for example, a leader of the sport

explanation.surface: A football administrator enjoys a privileged standing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'say' and question mark flag that a FIFA chief is only one example of a sporting head.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means ahead of rivals, well placed and holding an advantage.

clue.text: Device that can make the lock turn

definitions.text: Device that can make the lock turn

parts.words: Device that can make the lock turn
parts.note: reads like a key for a door, but the lock is a tress of hair and turning it means putting a curl in it

explanation.surface: A gadget that opens a door by rotating the lock.
explanation.definitionFit: A roller for hair twists a lock of hair into a curl.

clue.text: Fish has lost tail, the power-booster

indicators.note: has lost tail means the final letter is removed

parts.note: the turbot is a flatfish

explanation.surface: A tailless fish provides an extra surge of strength.
explanation.definitionFit: A turbo, a turbocharger, boosts an engine's power output.

clue.text: Not all sleep, it seems, in beds

indicators.note: Not all says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Apparently not everyone sleeps in beds.
explanation.definitionFit: Pit is slang for a bed, so in the pits means in beds, said of sleepers.

clue.text: Proper bust? A lie — it's false!

indicators.note: false signals that these letters are not in their true order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone protests that a claim about a fitting bust is untrue.
explanation.definitionFit: Suitable means appropriate or fitting, i.e. proper for the occasion.

clue.text: Predicament almost entirely due to quarrel

indicators.note: almost entirely means all but the last letter is kept

parts.note: a scrape is an awkward predicament

explanation.surface: A tricky situation is largely the result of a row.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrap is a fight or squabble, so it means a quarrel.

clue.text: One making slow progress in place — stranger

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street addresses
odder means more strange

explanation.surface: An outsider moves slowly through a locality.
explanation.definitionFit: A plodder walks heavily or works steadily without speed.

clue.text: Heavy metal's No. 1 performer

definitions.meaning: a dense grey metal, chemical symbol Pb
the star or principal actor in a production

explanation.definitionFit: Lead is a dense element, and the lead is a show's star role.

clue.text: 'It's most logical to change': experts warning of catastrophe?

indicators.note: to change says the letters of the quoted words must be rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: Scientists sounding an alarm insist that altering course is the sensible thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Climate scientists study long-term weather and many warn of disastrous global heating.

clue.text: Death interrupts Turkish commander's plan for action

indicators.note: interrupts means the death word breaks into the commander's title

parts.note: an aga is an Ottoman commander or official
end is a word for death

explanation.surface: A Turkish general's strategy is cut short by his demise.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is a list of business, a plan of what is to be done.

clue.text: A gun I fired to get a lizard

indicators.note: fired suggests the letters are blasted into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone shoots a gun to bag a reptile.
explanation.walkthrough: The final 'a' looks like part of the definition but supplies the second A for the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The iguana is a large tropical American lizard.

clue.text: Munitions are not put outside back of barrack-room in the morning

indicators.note: put outside means the contraction wraps around the other letters

parts.note: are not contracts to aren't

indicators.note: back of selects the final letter of the word

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: Weapons are not laid out behind the barracks at dawn.
explanation.definitionFit: Armament means military weapons and equipment, the same as munitions.

clue.text: Notice on discardable item in African country?

definitions.meaning: a label marking food as a takeaway, to be eaten elsewhere
a small West African state on the Gulf of Guinea

explanation.definitionFit: Takeaway packaging is marked to go; the same letters run together name a West African republic.

clue.text: Duke has Barnaby as a servant

parts.note: Barnaby Rudge is the title character of a Dickens novel

explanation.surface: An aristocrat employs a man called Barnaby as his menial.
explanation.definitionFit: A drudge does hard, dull menial work, like a lowly servant.

clue.text: Difficulty down below after good food

indicators.note: in a down clue, below after means this piece follows the other, sitting under it

parts.note: a rub is a difficulty, as in Hamlet's there's the rub

explanation.surface: Trouble lurks beneath decent cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: Grub is informal slang for food.

clue.text: The man given antibiotic initially was first to get better again

parts.note: he is the pronoun for the man

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter

parts.note: led means was in front, came first

explanation.surface: A patient given drugs was the first to recover.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone healed has recovered and is well once more, in good health again.

clue.text: Plant producing metalloid element — a thousand laid off

indicators.note: laid off means the letter is dismissed from the word

parts.note: germanium is a metalloid chemical element
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A factory making a chemical element sacks a thousand workers.
explanation.definitionFit: The geranium is a common garden and pot flowering plant.
